name: Offensive prompt packs
description: Four projects with no agent code (Claude-Red, pentest-ai-agents, codex-redteam-mode, vibe-pentest) that turn a coding agent into an attack tool
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from their files

indicators.context: Default install folder of the Claude-Red offensive skill pack (install.sh DEFAULT_TARGET; the README clones the repository to the same path). Holds 79 SKILL.md files named offensive-<topic>

indicators.context: Source link in 48 of the 79 Claude-Red SKILL.md files, which are rewritten from that checklist repository; a skill file that carries it on a host is a Claude-Red skill
